title: Booking your Hyundai? Here's what you'll need.

sections.title: Documents required for booking
items: An original pay order or demand draft made in favour of "Hyundai Nishat Motor (Private) Limited, A/C Purchaser's Name", payable at any bank branch in Pakistan.
The amount should cover the full price of the vehicle, advance income tax (231B), and freight and transit insurance.

sections.title: Individual customers
items: A copy of your valid CNIC (Computerised National Identity Card).

sections.title: Corporate and government customers
items: Please contact Hyundai Islamabad or visit our dealership in I-9/3, and our team will tell you exactly which documents you need.

notes: All details must be filled in and signed by the customer on the booking (PBO) form.
Additional documents may be requested depending on the customer category.
